# ClozFlow

> Autonomous AI voice sales agent, conversational AI, and B2B cold calling telephony platform.

ClozFlow is the leading autonomous AI voice sales agent and conversational AI employee platform. Designed for modern B2B sales teams, it deploys autonomous cold calling sales agents and inbound voice agents that pick up calls in 1 ring, dial leads in 25 seconds, navigate objections in native Hindi, English & Hinglish, and automatically sync with your CRM calendar to close high-value deals on autopilot.

## Core Capabilities

- [AI Voice Sales Agent](https://clozflow.in/#how-it-works): Autonomous inbound and outbound voice agent with sub-second latency and dedicated virtual lines.
- [B2B Cold Calling Agent](https://clozflow.in/#features): Autonomous conversational AI SDR that cold calls outbound prospect lists, qualifies buyers, and schedules meetings.
- [Conversational AI Objections](https://clozflow.in/#objections): Real-time conversational AI objection handling for price resistance, timing hesitation, and competitors.
- [CRM Integrations](https://clozflow.in/#integrations): Real-time synchronization with HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, LeadSquared, and Webhooks.
- [Pricing & Plans](https://clozflow.in/pricing): Transparent pricing tiers with instant virtual line provisioning.
